title: Stigmatiseringsonderzoek 1972
authors: Wouwe, S. van, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Criminologisch instituut (primary investigator)
descriptions: Study on attitudes towards people who have been in prison. Knowledge about prison and law / opinions about relation between punishment and crime / acceptation of a person with a criminal record / political attitude / religion / socio-economic status / statements about people who committed a crime. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ occupation/employment/ education/ politics/ religion
